entities.name: Ana Maria Filip
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana Maria Filip is a Romanian-born French professional basketball player who plays as a center for Tango Bourges Basket and the French national team. She participated at the 2014 FIBA World Championship and at the 2015 EuroBasket.
